cover_headline: China's Navy Passes 400 Ships, About 35% Larger Than the US Fleet by Hull Count
facts: China's navy now has a battle force of more than 400 ships and submarines, around 35% larger than the US Navy by hull count, according to official US numbers seen by the Wall Street Journal
Beijing has added 71 major warships and submarines since 2020, 19 of them in the last year alone; the US fleet remains larger by tonnage and stands at roughly 290 ships
US officials expect Chinese submarines to routinely operate in the Indian Ocean and Arctic approaches by 2040

end.headline: China's Navy Passes 400 Ships, About 35% Larger Than the US Fleet by Hull Count
end.line: Official US figures put China's battle force at more than 400 ships and submarines, with 71 major vessels added since 2020.
